recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中骨小樑間的造血組織比脂肪多，細胞密度高於同齡預期，可見三系造血與多顆巨核細胞；在此低倍 H&E 下漿細胞難以單獨辨認，需搭配 CD138 染色才知道細胞增加的原因。
features: Hypercellular marrow space between bony trabeculae with reduced fat
Trilineage hematopoiesis with scattered megakaryocytes of normal appearance
Mixed population of small and medium mononuclear cells; plasma cells not individually discernible at this power
Intact trabecular bone without obvious lytic change in this field
describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow trephine at low magnification shows marrow spaces between intact bony trabeculae that are hypercellular for age. There is trilineage hematopoiesis with adequate megakaryocytes and a mixed population of mononuclear cells, but no discrete sheets or nodules of plasma cells are identifiable at this power. The cause of the hypercellularity cannot be determined on H&E alone; CD138 immunostaining in this case revealed an interstitial plasma cell infiltrate of about 15% of cellularity. Findings are consistent with a hypercellular marrow with subtle involvement by a plasma cell neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Reactive hyperplasia shows orderly trilineage maturation without an increase in CD138-positive plasma cells or light-chain restriction.
MPN shows clustered, atypical or enlarged megakaryocytes and may have reticulin fibrosis, rather than normal megakaryocytes with an interstitial plasma cell increase.
MDS shows dysplastic megakaryocytes, abnormal localization of immature precursors and cytopenias, confirmed on aspirate morphology and cytogenetics.
